narrative.overview: A light, focused desk workspace for managing opportunities and preparing career documents. Warm neutral surfaces provide a quiet frame; forest green identifies actions and selection. Documentation is grounded in source review; rendered visual acceptance remains pending.
keyCharacteristics: Clear table hierarchy and restrained accents
Stable navigation with generous working space
Flat, bordered surfaces and compact controls
dos: Do preserve horizontal table scrolling and the wide-screen detail workflow.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and text labels.
donts: Don't introduce fabricated metrics or a marketing hero into the working area.
Don't apply shadows to ordinary workspace panels.
